newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Golf-Norman turns down showdown with Woods.
newsitem.headline: Golf-Norman turns down showdown with Woods.

text.p: World number one golfer Greg Norman said on Wednesday he had turned down a lucrative offer to face Tiger Woods in a head-to-head challenge for television.
Norman said he declined the chance of a best-of-three challenge against the U.S. Masters champion because the timing of the event was not suitable.
Norman said the offer was made to him one month ago by an independent television production company in the United States.
But he gave no futher details to reporters during a video link-up from his Florida base.
The Australian golfer called the news conference to announce his first venture as a tournament organiser in his homeland.
Great White Shark Enterprises will run the Greg Norman Holden International tournament at The Australian course in Sydney in February 1998.
The company has given a four-year commitment to stage the tournament.
Norman has lent his name to tournaments in Australia before but this will be the first time he assumes total responsibility.
